name: @saasreport/format
description: The one number formatter of the kit: numbers, percentages, ordinals, ranges, times and dates in the digits and separators of the locale (Persian digits ۰–۹ with ٬ and ٫ for fa), and the scanner behind `kit check digits`. Its one dependency is the import-free @saasreport/calendar/instant (Solar Hijri dates by arithmetic, inlined into the browser bundle); runs in Workers, Node ≥ 20 and browsers.
